details.description: DeepSeek-Coder-7B-Base, served by Fireworks AI under this id, is DeepSeek AI's 6.7-billion-parameter base code model from the original DeepSeek-Coder series; its canonical Hugging Face repository is named deepseek-coder-6.7b-base. It was trained from scratch on 2 trillion tokens (87% code, 13% natural language in English and Chinese) with a native 16K-token context window, though Fireworks serves it at 4,096 tokens. As a base model it is built for code completion and fill-in-the-middle infilling rather than instruction-following chat, and DeepSeek's current API no longer lists any DeepSeek-Coder v1 model.
advantages: Averages 44.7% pass@1 across eight languages on DeepSeek's multilingual HumanEval benchmark and scores 60.6% on MBPP, per DeepSeek's technical report.
DeepSeek's technical report states this 6.7B model "surpasses the performance of CodeLlama-Base 34B" despite having roughly five times fewer parameters.
Trained with a fill-in-the-middle (FIM) objective in addition to next-token prediction, supporting code infilling as well as completion, per DeepSeek's model card.
disadvantages: A base model, not instruction-tuned, so it is built for code completion rather than chat-style dialogue.
DeepSeek's own current API no longer lists any DeepSeek-Coder v1 model; available only as open weights or via third-party hosts such as Fireworks.
Fireworks serves it with a 4,096-token context window, well short of the model's native 16K-token design.
Natural-language training data covers only English and Chinese, per DeepSeek's model card.

sources.title: DeepSeek-Coder: When the Large Language Model Meets Programming -- The Rise of Code Intelligence

notes: Fireworks' id 'deepseek-coder-7b-base' maps to DeepSeek's deepseek-coder-6.7b-base: huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/deepseek-coder-7b-base 307-redirects to huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/deepseek-coder-6.7b-base, and DeepSeek's own benchmark tables label this size '6.7B'. Catalog facts of 4096 max input/output tokens match Fireworks' listed context window (the model's native pretraining window is 16K, per DeepSeek's paper). DeepSeek's current API pricing page (checked 2026-09-24) no longer lists this or any DeepSeek-Coder v1 model.
